criticalIssues.title: Missing progress.weightChart translation in English
criticalIssues.description: Translation key progress.weightChart is missing from en.json. Hebrew translation exists. Component displays raw key instead of translated text.

criticalIssues.title: Hardcoded Windows file paths in check_in.py
criticalIssues.description: Hardcoded Windows paths with user-specific path will break on Linux/Mac. Debug logging should use relative paths or environment variables.
criticalIssues.fix: Remove hardcoded paths, use relative paths or environment variables, consider removing debug logging

criticalIssues.title: Debug endpoints expose sensitive information
criticalIssues.description: Debug endpoints /api/debug/env and /api/debug/paths expose environment variables and file system paths. Should be disabled in production or protected with admin-only access.

highPriorityIssues.title: Hardcoded Hebrew fallback strings

highPriorityIssues.title: Language persistence issue - fallbackLng should change when user changes language
highPriorityIssues.description: fallbackLng is hardcoded to 'he'. When user changes language to English, the fallback should also be English, not Hebrew. Currently, if translation is missing or language detection fails, it falls back to Hebrew even if user prefers English.
highPriorityIssues.fix: Update fallbackLng to use stored language preference from localStorage. If user has selected English, fallback should be 'en'. If user has selected Hebrew, fallback should be 'he'. Default to 'he' only if no preference is stored.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Training UI has unnecessary elements - arrow, exercise count, tags, body weight toggle
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Training client view has: 1) Arrow on left side (ChevronRight icon) that should be removed, 2) Number of exercises display that should be removed, 3) Tags/badges under training description (מותאם אישית, 3 אימנים בשבוע, etc.) - should only show training plan name and description, 4) Body weight toggle in exercises that should be removed.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Remove ChevronRight arrow icon from training day cards. Remove exercise count display. Remove all tags/badges under training description (keep only training plan name and description). Remove body weight checkbox and related logic from exercise display in TrainingDayPage.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Training completion calendar missing - need calendar that marks completed training days
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Need calendar view that marks training when training was completed. Training completed button exists in TrainingDayPage.tsx but calendar visualization is missing. Calendar should show which days training was completed.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Add calendar component (use react-calendar or similar) showing training days with completion status. Mark completed days visually (different color/icon). Ensure completion tracking works correctly. Calendar should be visible in TrainingPlanV2 or TrainingPage.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Food bank has duplicate filters - need consolidation
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Food bank has two filter UIs - one under search and another under the box. To filter protein, user must select both protein tags which is confusing.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Remove duplicate filter UI. Keep single filter selector (either under search or as tabs, not both). Ensure filter works correctly with single selection.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Meal system needs per-portion vs per-100g option
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Some food items shouldn't be per 100g (e.g., slice of bread should be per portion - 1 slice, 2 slices). Need option to select either per gram or per portion.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Add measurement_type field to FoodOption and MealBank models (per_100g or per_portion). Add UI selector (radio buttons). Update quantity input to show appropriate units. Update calorie calculation logic.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Client meal view shows per-meal calories/macros - should only show daily totals (verification needed)
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Client meal tracking view should not show calories and macros for each individual meal. Should only display daily totals. Per-meal breakdown should be removed. Marked as resolved but needs verification.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Verify per-meal calorie and macro display is removed. Keep only daily totals visible with progress visualization. If still present, remove per-meal breakdown grid.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Client food selection limited to recommended foods - should allow all food bank items (verification needed)
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Clients should be able to choose from all food bank options, not just recommended foods. Trainer recommends amount in grams, but client can override and choose different foods/quantities. Calories should be counted automatically. Marked as resolved but needs verification.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Verify client can choose from all food bank items. Show trainer recommendations but allow adding any food. Allow removing recommended foods (swipe to delete). Update calorie calculation to handle any food combination.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Excel import for food plans (resolved - verification needed)
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Excel import for meal plans is implemented. Supports 4-sheet Excel structure with Hebrew text duplicate detection. Marked as resolved but needs verification that it works correctly.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Verify Excel import works correctly. Test with sample Excel file. Ensure duplicate detection works properly.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Food bank Excel import needs duplicate detection with Hebrew text matching (resolved - verification needed)
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Hebrew text normalization and fuzzy matching using Levenshtein distance is implemented. Marked as resolved but needs verification that duplicate detection works correctly when importing food bank items.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Verify Hebrew text matching works correctly. Test duplicate detection with similar Hebrew food names. Ensure popup shows potential matches correctly.

mediumPriorityIssues.title: Meal system - trainer should manually calculate and set calories/macros per day
mediumPriorityIssues.description: Trainer should be able to manually set total calories and macro targets (protein, carbs, fat in grams) for each day. Trainer calculates manually and sets values. System should not auto-calculate or override trainer input.
mediumPriorityIssues.fix: Ensure trainer can manually input total calories and macro targets (protein, carbs, fat in grams) for the meal plan. Remove any auto-calculation that overrides trainer input. Verify manual input is saved correctly.
